title: Gitea
description: Gitea scrape health, repository and issue inventory, Go runtime, and resources for the application and database containers.

panels.title: Metrics scrape
panels.description: Result of the most recent Prometheus scrape of Gitea’s metrics endpoint.

panels.title: Gitea version
panels.description: Version reported by Gitea.

panels.title: Accounts
panels.description: Active and inactive account records reported by Gitea.

panels.title: Scrape status history
panels.description: Each sample records whether Prometheus could read the metrics endpoint. Gaps indicate missing observations.

panels.title: Successful scrapes
panels.description: Fraction of recorded scrape samples that succeeded in the selected range. Periods without samples are excluded.

panels.title: Observed restarts
panels.description: Changes in the reported process start time within the selected range. Restarts between observations can be missed.

panels.title: Scrape duration
panels.description: Time Prometheus spent fetching the metrics endpoint.

panels.title: Samples per scrape
panels.description: Samples returned before and after metric relabeling.

panels.title: Repository inventory
panels.description: Current inventory over time.

panels.title: Issue inventory
panels.description: Issue counts by state over time.

panels.title: Repositories by issue count
panels.description: Up to ten repositories ranked by total issues reported by Gitea. This panel requires per-repository issue metrics.

panels.title: Accounts and organizations
panels.description: Active and inactive are Gitea account states.

panels.title: Release and collaboration inventory
panels.description: Gauge counts as recorded by Gitea.

panels.title: Automation task records
panels.description: Task records reported by Gitea, without status labels.

panels.title: Process CPU
panels.description: User and system CPU seconds per second. One core represents one CPU-second per second.

panels.title: Resident memory and Go heap
panels.description: Related memory measures. These series overlap.

panels.title: File descriptor use
panels.description: Open file descriptors as a percentage of the process limit.

panels.title: Go garbage collection pauses
panels.description: Duration quantiles from Go’s garbage collector summary.

panels.title: Go allocation rate
panels.description: Bytes allocated per second, including objects that are later freed.

panels.title: Container CPU by service
panels.description: cAdvisor series for the selected Compose project on the Gitea target’s server.

panels.title: Container memory working set
panels.description: cAdvisor series for the selected Compose project on the Gitea target’s server.

panels.title: Container network RX
panels.description: Container interface traffic, excluding loopback. Traffic between services can appear in both directions.

panels.title: Container network TX
panels.description: Container interface traffic, excluding loopback. Traffic between services can appear in both directions.
